init.title: ClimateOptimizer options
init.description: Pick a section to edit. Each page saves on its own.

sensors.title: Sensors and inputs
sensors.description: Which entities to read, and which weather-derived inputs to use at all. Switching an input off removes it from the thermal model too, not just from the calculation.

data.power_sensor: Heat pump power sensor (optional, may include hot water)

data_description.weather_entity: Only used for wind and sun. Leave empty if both inputs below are off.
data_description.enable_solar_input: Backs the heating off when the sun is warming the house.
data_description.enable_wind_input: Compensates for extra heat loss on windy days.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.description: Your preferences. Nothing here is ever auto-tuned — no measurement of the house can tell us what temperature you want. The target temperature itself is a separate entity so automations can move it.

data.heating_cutoff_c: Summer cutoff (compensation off at/above this outdoor temperature)

tuning.title: Tuning and auto-tune
tuning.description: Which path sets the controller's coefficients. Manual uses the numbers below exactly as typed. Auto derives them from your house's measured thermal behaviour, starting from these same numbers and easing across as the model gathers evidence, falling back to them whenever it isn't confident. Nothing here is wasted in Auto mode: every coefficient below is still the seed and the safety net. The derived values are published on the auto-tune sensors in both modes, so you can compare for a season before committing. To switch modes later use the tuning-mode entity, not this page.

data_description.tuning_mode: Seeds the tuning-mode entity on first run only, so this box does nothing on an existing install. Use the entity to change modes.
data_description.heating_type: Read only by auto-tune, and ignored completely in Manual mode. Its one job is to stop the derived coefficients from correcting faster than your emitters can physically deliver.
data_description.k_indoor: Manual: used exactly as typed. Auto: the starting point, and the fallback whenever the model is not trusted.
data_description.k_wind: Manual: used exactly as typed. Auto: the starting point, and the fallback whenever the model is not trusted.
data_description.k_sun: Manual: used exactly as typed. Auto: the starting point, and the fallback whenever the model is not trusted.

price.title: Price and savings
price.description: How hard to trade comfort for cheaper energy. The Low/Mid/High tier is a separate entity so it can be automated. With a day-ahead forecast the price band is taken from the day's own spread and the two thresholds below are only a fallback. Four settings here are also read by auto-tune and are marked as such: the braking gain, and the three deep-cold taper knobs that Auto replaces with a recovery-feasibility calculation from the thermal model once that model is trusted.

data.enable_price_compensation: Lower target during expensive price periods
data.precharge_max_boost_c: Max pre-heat boost before a spike (High tier only; 0 disables)
data.price_threshold_max: Price where reduction is at its maximum (fallback)
data.cold_taper_start_c: Deep-cold taper: full braking at or above this outdoor temp
data.cold_taper_full_c: Deep-cold taper: minimum braking at or below this outdoor temp
data.cold_taper_min_factor: Deep-cold taper: braking fraction at the coldest end (0-1)

data_description.k_price: Manual: used exactly as typed. Auto: the starting point, and the fallback whenever the model is not trusted.
data_description.price_threshold_start: Never auto-tuned. Only used at all when no day-ahead price forecast is available.
data_description.precharge_max_boost_c: Never auto-tuned. This is a comfort preference, not a property of the house.
data_description.cold_taper_start_c: Manual: these three draw the taper by hand. Auto: they seed it and stay the fallback, but once the model is trusted the taper is computed from whether the comfort sag is actually recoverable in your house.
data_description.cold_taper_full_c: Manual: used as typed. Auto: seed and fallback only.
data_description.cold_taper_min_factor: Manual: used as typed. Auto: seed and fallback only.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings for the learned thermal model that auto-tune sits on top of, and for the advisory MPC planner. MPC never affects the published temperature - with one exception, marked below, where an MPC setting is also read by auto-tune.

data.enable_wind_rc: Estimate wind sensitivity in the thermal model (only for leaky, exposed houses)
data.rc_wind_reference_ms: Reference wind speed for the wind model
data.mpc_max_heating_delta_c: MPC max heating authority - also read by auto-tune
data.mpc_min_confidence: MPC minimum RC-model confidence to be trustworthy
data.enable_data_logging: Log data locally for offline model testing

data_description.enable_wind_rc: Feeds the thermal model, so in Auto mode it reaches the controller through auto-tune. Separate from the wind input on the Sensors page, which feeds the coefficient directly.
data_description.rc_wind_reference_ms: Read by both the thermal model and auto-tune's derived wind coefficient.
data_description.mpc_horizon_hours: Advisory only. Changing it cannot affect the published temperature.
data_description.mpc_max_heating_delta_c: Despite the name, not MPC-only: auto-tune also reads it as the available heating authority in its recovery-feasibility taper, so in Auto mode it does influence price braking.
data_description.mpc_min_confidence: Advisory only. Governs the reported trustworthiness flag and nothing else.
data_description.enable_data_logging: Never affects control. Writes a local JSONL file for offline analysis.

output.title: Output push
output.description: Optional ways to send the compensated temperature to your heat pump. Both are independent — set one, both, or neither.

output_number_push.name: Update a number entity
output_number_push.description: Sets the published compensated outdoor temperature into a number entity, e.g. `number.ohmigo_temperature` if OhmOnWifi/OhmigoWifi is set up as a MQTT entity. Mirrors what the main sensor publishes (real outdoor temp while the activation switch is off/learn-mode, compensated once it's on). Off by default.

ohmonwifi_direct.name: OhmOnWifi direct API
ohmonwifi_direct.description: Push the compensated outdoor temperature straight to an OhmOnWifi/Ohmigo device's own local HTTP API. Off by default. The save is rejected if it can't be reached.

data.ohmonwifi_host: Hostname or IP (optional, e.g. ohmonwifi.local - the device's own mDNS default name)

rc_thermal_time_constant.name: Auto-tune: RC model thermal time constant

rc_heat_pump_gain.name: Auto-tune: RC model heat pump gain
